target.title: fix(agents): scale aggregate tool-result budget with context window and compact on pressure
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #100042.

OpenClaw had a unit mismatch between window-relative compaction and an absolute aggregate tool-result cap. Large `contextWindow` sessions could hit the 256k-char aggregate tool-result clamp on every model call long before window-relative compaction saw pressure, silently truncating even fresh tool output to empty content while only emitting an INFO-level signal.

## Why This Change Was Made

The aggregate tool-result budget now scales with the model context window: `max(perResultMaxChars * 4, floor(contextWindowTokens * 4 * 0.5))`. The 0.5 share mirrors safeguard compaction `maxHistoryShare` and `SINGLE_TOOL_RESULT_CONTEXT_SHARE`, while the 4x per-result floor preserves existing small-window behavior.

Trailing tool results are structurally excluded from aggregate clearing and protected with the 2000-char min-keep floor when truncation is still needed. Protected trailing aggregate pressure is reported separately from destructive replacements, so fresh output can request compaction without being erased.

Aggregate engagement is routed through the existing precheck overflow recovery as `compact_then_truncate`, so the session performs real compaction and then runs the persistent tool-result truncation backstop for forward progress. Failure mode is bounded: `MAX_OVERFLOW_COMPACTION_ATTEMPTS = 3`, then one persistent truncation attempt, then explicit give-up with the existing blocked context-overflow response; no unbounded compaction loop.

## User Impact

Large-`contextWindow` sessions no longer silently lose fresh tool output just because the absolute aggregate cap was hit. Operators get a once-per-session WARN with `/compact` and `/new` hints when aggregate pressure engages. Small-window behavior is unchanged because the old 4x aggregate floor is preserved.

## Evidence

Field evidence for the failure mode is documented in issue #100042.

Verification run after the final rebase:

- `pnpm tsgo` — passed, exit code 0.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/tool-result-truncation.test.ts` — passed, 47 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.spawn-workspace.context-engine.test.ts` — passed, 69 tests.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main --prompt-file <issue-context>` — clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
